summary: Reveal internal construction while distinguishing an explanatory display transform from the real assembly.
objective: At zero explosion every part returns to its exact assembly transform; at full separation attachment relationships remain understandable.
example_prompts: Reveal internal construction while distinguishing an explanatory display transform from the real assembly.

principles: Choose cutaway for spatial continuity and explode for attachment order. State when displacement is purely explanatory.
Preserve a rest assembly and label removed or shifted parts; a floating part should have an obvious inspection reason.
implementation: For WebGL material clipping, enable localClippingEnabled and use world-space planes. Inspect shadow clipping separately.
For explosion, derive display offsets from saved rest poses and a single progress value; do not mutate semantic coordinates cumulatively.
If the cut should show a solid cross-section, author a suitable cap or section mesh; hiding fragments alone is not an interior model.
observable_checks: At zero explosion every part returns to its exact assembly transform; at full separation attachment relationships remain understandable.
Move a cut plane: interior labels and boundaries agree with the revealed geometry rather than suggesting a hollow object accidentally.

known_limits: Rendering clips do not certify watertight geometry or factual interior anatomy; exploded poses are not physically attainable by default.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.

claims.statement: Material clipping planes are world-space planes and require WebGLRenderer local clipping to be enabled; shadow clipping is separately configurable.
